notes: «قال أنبأنا ح» : the first branch names no shaykh after «أنبأنا», so it is read as the one name; the point where it meets the second branch is not written and is not filled
«عن أبيه، عن جده» are bare relations (rule 7); the last link is the grandfather
«زاد عثمان» (a wording addition) is left out
